messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Incident opened: Observability ingestion delays detected for Datadog US-EAST region — logs and metrics showing >10m lag, partial traces missing. auto-priority: high.

maria (sre-oncall): ack, I'm looking. getting paged now. anyone seen errors from forwarder?

sam (infra): seeing a lot of 429s from api.datadoghq.com from our log-forwarder pool. sample curl: `curl -I https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/series -H 'DD-API-KEY: <masked>'` returns 429 and `Retry-After: 120`.

jess (observability): confirmed. datadog status shows ingestion backpressure + throttling in US-EAST. dashboards stop updating at 02:10 UTC. traces start dropping around 02:07.

maria (sre-oncall): impact: customer-facing request alerting may be blind; autoscaling dashboards stale. paging oncall and support for customer-facing communs. tagging incident.inc-obsv-dd-ingest.

support-bot: Noted. Creating customer-impact list for active customers with alerts.

sam (infra): mitigation ideas: (1) reduce forwarder concurrency to avoid hammering back, (2) switch non-critical log streams to S3 backup, (3) turn on local aggregation and sampling. leaning to 1+3 immediately.

jess (observability): agree. Also enable CloudWatch fallback for infra metrics where we have it. I'll start a runbook checklist.

maria (sre-oncall): ok do (1) throttle forwarder to 2 concurrency, move debug logs to S3, and set sample_rate=0.1 for internal tracing. Sam, can you push throttle config?

sam (infra): pushing change now: `kubectl set env deploy/log-forwarder FORWARDER_CONCURRENCY=2 --namespace=prod`

incident-bot: deploybot: rollout started for deploy/log-forwarder (rev 842) by sam.

sam (infra): rollout healthy on 4/6 pods, two still restarting due to transient 429 retries. monitoring.

jess (observability): enabling CloudWatch fallback for host-metrics: toggled `fallback.cloudwatch=true` in observability-config. Metrics start arriving (delayed) but fine for critical alarms.

maria (sre-oncall): customer impact assessment: 12 active customers with >=1 critical alert in last 15m, 3 with support cases potentially affected. Prepare a targeted msg for those 3.

support-bot: Drafting message to org support: "We're experiencing partial observability due to third-party ingestion throttling (Datadog). We're mitigating with throttles and fallbacks; some dashboards/alerts may be delayed. We'll update in 30m or on major change."

sam (infra): Datadog support ticket opened (ID: DD-485912). Initial response ETA 15-30m. Sharing link: https://support.datadoghq.com/ticket/DD-485912 (internal).

jess (observability): note: logs for payment-service are missing trace IDs between 02:07-02:18 — might need replay from buffered S3. I'll start capture and coordinate with platform team to schedule a replay after we confirm ingestion normal.

maria (sre-oncall): good. We'll avoid a broad status page incident for now until we have more duration. Setting checklist: mitigations applied, dd ticket opened, customer comm draft, logs queued to S3.

incident-bot: escalation: paging oncall-night ryan in 10m unless acknowledged.

ryan (oncall-night): ack I see thread. taking primary for the night in 10. any specific unfinished actions?

maria (sre-oncall): handing off — summary for you: Datadog US-EAST ingestion throttling causing >10m lag for logs/metrics/traces; we've throttled forwarders, enabled CloudWatch fallback, S3 buffering for debug streams, opened DD ticket DD-485912, customer comm drafted. Key open: replay buffered logs, follow-up with datadog support, update impacted customers if lag persists >30m.

ryan (oncall-night): got it. I'll monitor DD ticket and keep sam/jess looped. If DD doesn't respond in 20m escalate to SE contact + pager.

maria (sre-oncall): thanks — handing off formally: pausing my rotation. ryan you have incident lead. I'll still be reachable. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Customer notification sent to the 3 impacted accounts (internal ticket refs included).

sam (infra): forwarder concurrency stabilized, 6/6 pods healthy. rate of 429s decreased but still present at low volume.

jess (observability): traces still partial; replay queued (size ~2.3GB) to S3://redwood-replay/dd-buffer/1934567890. Will coordinate window for replay once DD verifies acceptance.

ryan (oncall-night): logging this handoff note into the incident tracker. next update in 15 unless conditions change.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigations applied; monitoring. next-check-in: in 15m.

maria (sre-oncall): thanks everyone. good coordination. :thumbsup:
